article.title: The Levy Institute mourns the passing of Anwar Shaikh
article.author: Editor
article.content: The Levy Institute mourns the passing of Anwar Shaikh, an outstanding scholar, teacher, and mentor to a generation of socially committed economists, including several current and former Levy Institute scholars. On this solemn occasion of deep loss, we extend our condolences to his family, friends, and loved ones. The post The Levy Institute mourns the passing of Anwar Shaikh appeared first on MR Online .
